to  appoint  staff,  the  composition  of  which  shall
reflect the pluralistic nature of Sri Lanka, including
gender, and to provide training facilities to them as
relevant  to  the  work  of  the  Commission.  The
Commission  may  request  secondment  of  public
officers to the Commission;
to dismiss staff for good cause;
to  establish  committees,  units  or  divisions  in
addition  to  those  units  and  divisions  specifically
mentioned  in  this  Act,  to  perform  duties  and
functions of the Commission;
to  delegate  powers  to  such  committees,  units,

divisions  or 
individuals  appointed  by

Commission as appropriate and necessary;
to enter into agreements with any person or entity
necessary  to  achieve  the  objectives  of  the
Commission including Office on Missing Persons,
Office for Reparations, Office for National Unity
and Reconciliation, the National Authority for the
Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses and
the Department of National Archives;
to raise funds in order to achieve the objectives of
the  Commission,  including  but  not  limited  to
obtaining any grants, gifts or endowments:
